# varnish_org_user (Resource)

An organization user, managed uniformly whether the invite is still pending or already accepted (a member). Creating sends an invite; once accepted the same resource represents the member. Removing/updating accepted members may require an org-admin-scoped access token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Valid role names for the organization.
data "varnish_roles" "all" {}

# Creating sends an invite; the same resource represents the user once the
# invite is accepted (status flips from "pending" to "member").
resource "varnish_org_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
  role  = "Admin" # a name from data.varnish_roles.all; matched case-insensitively
}

output "alice_status" {
  value = varnish_org_user.alice.status # "pending" or "member"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the invited/member user.
- `role` (String) Org role name as defined in the organization (e.g. "Admin", "Finance", "Developer"; see the varnish_roles data source). Matched case-insensitively. Updated in place.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account ID when the user is an accepted member; null while pending.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier org_id:email, e.g. 2031304261:alice@example.com. Stable across pending and member states.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID the user belongs to: the organization the access token is scoped to.
- `status` (String) Current state: "pending" (invite not yet accepted) or "member" (accepted).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = varnish_org_user.alice
  identity = {
    org_id = "1"
    email  = "alice@example.com"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `org_id` (String) Organization ID the user belongs to.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Org users are imported by "<org_id>:<email>".
terraform import varnish_org_user.alice "1:alice@example.com"
```
